name: Eviction laws by state and territory: notice, cure, just cause, fees and timing (LSC)
description: How the law of each U.S. state, the District of Columbia and five territories regulates residential evictions as of January 1, 2021, coded from the statutes by the Legal Services Corporation and Temple University's Center for Public Health Law Research: the notice a landlord must give before filing for nonpayment, whether a tenant may cure, whether a landlord needs a stated cause, caps on late fees, the filing fee the law sets, the days to answer, to appeal and between writ and removal, mediation, and the statute cited for the notice rule. One record per jurisdiction plus a national summary.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Eviction laws by state and territory: notice, cure, just cause, fees and timing (LSC) (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963453

distribution.name: eviction-laws.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: eviction-laws.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: eviction-laws-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in eviction-laws-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to eviction-laws.csv on id.

recordSet.name: eviction-laws
recordSet.description: The records of Eviction laws by state and territory: notice, cure, just cause, fees and timing (LSC), one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state or territory code, or US for the national summary

field.name: level
field.description: state, or us for the national summary

field.name: status
field.description: S: a compilation of the law made by LSC and Temple University, not the statute text

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
